primary_review.strict_window: prior regular close < company announcement and declared revision < current regular open; aggregator timestamps alone cannot establish this
primary_review.review_budget: up to 8 successful/error source requests per case; up to 4 extra only to resolve an alreadyfound first-party timestamp/version conflict; include failed/ambiguous cases, no forced pass
primary_review.allowed_sources: issuer IR, issuer-issued original wire, government or SEC exchange filings; search/list/index only discovery; raw bodies private
primary_review.classification: clinical data/enrollment and analyst targets alone outside categories; executed agreements count without inventing revenue requirement; completed regulatory communication can qualify but not label approval
primary_review.unknown: No found qualifying source does not prove absence; keep missing/ambiguous as unknown for strict candidate selection. Identified outside-category story does not prove no other story.

implementation.intent_sort: earliest signal completion, descending first30 volume / prior20 mean volume, lexical symbol; causal inputs only
implementation.quantity: floor(fraction * settledcash / (signal_close * (1+cost))); select first signal even if unaffordable; zero quantity skips day, no replacement
implementation.execution_affordability: keep intended quantity; entry open*(1+cost)*quantity must remain <= initial intent budget and settled cash; else skip day without resize/replacement
implementation.latency: unchanged one full minute after completed signal: signal source minute m, intent m+1, entry reference m+2
implementation.stops: OR30 low fixed; active entry minute; subsequent gap below stop uses lower open; missing minute before exit keeps unresolved exposure; entry open<=stop marks incomplete ambiguity, never favorable stop credit
implementation.exits: fixed10 entry session=1; last regular minute OPEN on session10. MA10 simple mean 10 completed vendor daily closes including decision day, strict close<MA; next regular open; maximum63 scheduled last-minute OPEN. Early closes per calendar.
implementation.simultaneous_open_events: one exit only; known scheduled/MA exit and gap-stop use same observed open and cost; include combined reasons, no favorable price choice
implementation.corporate_actions: use cached improved action records; if relevant held event requires unverified currency/mapping/entitlement or unsupported share/receivable adjustment, stop as incomplete with exposure instead of silently ignoring or zeroing it; before-entry prior9 MA splits require comparable source adjustment or remain unknown
implementation.settlement: sales are T+1 receivables using calendar settlement_date, not spendable until that session; no same-day recycling; no borrowing
implementation.terminal: cutoff Oct5 hold censored with last observed source mark, not forced sale; incomplete paths ending_equity null
implementation.unknown_candidate_precedence: when flat, a possible earlier/tied unresolved market/news candidate blocks complete strict path. If missing initial daily screening coverage or cohort completeness unknown, keep original source limits and explicit incomplete/conditional designation. No silently dropped unresolved case.
implementation.arithmetic: Decimal via string numeric inputs; preserve exact ledger decimals; presentation rounding only
implementation.restart: separate future experiment; do not simulate new500 injections without frozen inability-to-trade criterion

diagnostics.meaning: independent hypothetical500 initial case ledgers, not daily resets or portfolio wealth; news pass/fail/unknown joined afterward, not filtered before exit input download
diagnostics.quotes: prior entry quote diagnostics attached separately; OHLC25/50/100bp remain stress models; no exit fill/executable claim

publication: only new exchange/codex paths; all cases/failed/incomplete/ledgers/code/manifests; no fullraw news/market feeds or private paths/credentials
